scripts.typecheck: tsc -p packages/core/tsconfig.json && tsc -p packages/ingest/tsconfig.json && tsc -p packages/queue/tsconfig.json && tsc -p packages/server/tsconfig.json && tsc -p packages/cli/tsconfig.json && tsc -p tsconfig.json
scripts.check: bun run lint && bun run typecheck && bun test
scripts.build:core: bun build packages/core/src/index.ts --outdir packages/core/dist --target node --format esm
scripts.compat:node: bun run build:core && bun run build:ingest && bun run build:queue && node packages/core/test/compat/smoke.mjs && node packages/ingest/test/compat/smoke.mjs && node packages/queue/test/compat/smoke.mjs
scripts.test:live: EET_TEST_LIVE=1 bun test packages/core/test/live packages/queue/test/live packages/server/test/live packages/cli/test/live
scripts.build:ingest: bun build packages/ingest/src/index.ts --outdir packages/ingest/dist --target node --format esm
scripts.build:queue: bun build packages/queue/src/index.ts --outdir packages/queue/dist --target node --format esm
